controls.title: Organizational Context & Mission Alignment
controls.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management decisions.

controls.title: Physical and Virtual Asset Inventory
controls.description: Inventories of hardware and virtual devices managed by the organization are maintained.

controls.title: Identity Management and Authentication
controls.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed.

controls.title: Data-at-Rest Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: Data at rest are protected according to the organization's risk strategy.

controls.title: Network and Environmental Monitoring
controls.description: Networks and environments are monitored to detect potential cybersecurity events.

controls.title: Incident Response Plan Execution
controls.description: The incident response plan is executed during or after an incident.
